name: knowledge-base
description: True RAG over your own Markdown docs: a local ChromaDB vector index plus your embeddings API. Captures new notes back into it. Requires chromadb.

embed_url.title: Embeddings endpoint URL
embed_url.description: Full URL of your embeddings API. REQUIRED. The Python interpreter and the indexed corpus come from the suite-wide EVA_PYTHON and EVA_KNOWLEDGE_DIR environment variables - this server indexes the WHOLE knowledge root, and captures notes into its 'captures' sub-folder. Both must exist; see the plugin README.

embed_model.title: Embeddings model
embed_model.description: Optional. Model name sent in embed requests; omit if the endpoint fixes one.
